collection.title: Proton Impian 2001 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Proton Impian 2001 to 2008 model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
